title: Deploy to one Fly machine with a volume; keys in the secret store
done_when: make suite BACKEND=http passes every test against the deployed URL
constraints: Read AGENTS.md first; the spec wins over the code
Never edit conformance-draft/ tests or SPEC.md in this task, and never weaken a test
Writes are POST only; a GET on a write path answers 405 and changes nothing
No key, token or credential in any response, page, log or commit
Run make check before committing; one task per branch; do not push
Taylor runs and approves every deploy
Serve only behind the Cloudflare edge: TESSERA_EDGE_SECRET on Fly equals EDGE_SECRET on the tessera Worker, and /board loads there with no content-security-policy violations
